paper_title: A Search for Hidden Sector Photons with ADMX
notes: Light-shining-through-wall style search with emitter/detector microwave cavities (not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies). Main result: excludes hidden photon kinetic mixing chi > 3.48e-8 at 95% CL for masses near 3 ueV (722.725 MHz). Lower masses excluded with reduced sensitivity per Fig. 4; only the primary quoted point is extracted from text. A projected upgrade sensitivity of chi<1e-9 is also mentioned but not included. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 1))
